title: Genesis 15:1–3 — Abram childless; Eliezer of Damascus his heir
summary: Genesis 15:1–3 in English: God tells Abram in a vision that He is his shield and great reward, and Abram answers that he is childless, so Eliezer of Damascus, a servant in his household, will be his heir. 'Eliezer' and 'servant' are highlighted in gold and 'Abram' in blue.

text.text: 1 “After this, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”
2 But Abram said, “O Sovereign LORD, what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
3 And Abram said, “You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir.”

uncertain: Hebrew reference header writes chapter 15 as יה (not the usual טו); transcribed as shown
